correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and quantifiers are explicit. The proof constructs the exact two-dimensional uniform block plus invariant transverse sectors, handles coincident eigenvalues by adding the correct cross projector, proves the finite set of resonance couplings and positive projector trace, and obtains the sinc critical window from exact Fourier integration with uniformly separated other gaps. The full equal-clique finite-window formula is independently derived. The delivered verifier checked 1,330 spectral comparisons, including resonance, with maximal infinite-average discrepancy below 2.3e-14; numerical checks are not used as general proof.

value.rationale: The excluded degenerate case in the closest physical model produces a sharp measurable localization discontinuity, not a cosmetic reformulation. The projector law gives an exact spatial redistribution and a strictly positive total return-trace jump on arbitrary regular components, whereas the sinc window establishes an experimentally meaningful weight-calibration scale; for equal cliques it is \(1/(nT)\), with an exact finite-observation probability formula. These are motivated structural limits beyond a routine fixed-size numerical check.
